caption: The video showcases a metallic four-arm spinner resting flat on a black rectangular pedestal against a plain white background. The spinner, built around a central ball-bearing ring with four cylindrical end weights joined by brass connector blocks, remains stationary about its vertical axis throughout the excerpt. A small dark notch on the bearing ring stays fixed at its upper edge, indicating no rotation. The arms hold a consistent diagonal orientation relative to the stationary camera. The polished weights and gold blocks show no lateral movement, and specular highlights remain constant across their curved surfaces. The object keeps its height and contact with the pedestal essentially constant, showing no onset, impact, or completion within the visible portion.
relations: The four-arm spinner rests flat on the black pedestal, maintaining constant height and contact throughout the clip.
The central bearing ring and its dark notch remain fixed, preventing any rotation about the vertical axis.
The arms hold a consistent diagonal orientation, with the polished weights and brass blocks showing no lateral movement.
Specular highlights on the curved metallic surfaces remain constant, indicating a stationary object against the white background.
